question: For each instance VM state, show the VM state and compute the average, range, and variance of the instance root disk size (ROOT_GB) considering only instances that have a system metadata entry with KEY = 'image_image_type' and that are running on host 'blaze8-12'. Do not return any rounded answers.

SELECT 
    i.vm_state,
    AVG(i.root_gb) AS avg_root_gb,
    MAX(i.root_gb) - MIN(i.root_gb) AS range_root_gb,
    VAR_SAMP(i.root_gb) AS var_root_gb
FROM instances i
JOIN instance_system_metadata m
  ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid
 AND m.`key` = 'image_image_type'
WHERE i.host = 'blaze8-12'
GROUP BY i.vm_state;
